verdict.rationale: pnpm is a drop-in replacement for npm, meaning it installs from the same npm registry, giving access to the same large, actively maintained package ecosystem; docs confirm compatibility with existing npm projects and workflows without migration, and community reviews confirm real-world adoption for installing packages across large monorepos. missing for 10: no explicit first-party statement about registry size/breadth or independent data on package compatibility coverage beyond npm-compatible registries.
